interactions.note: First-order loss to nothing. No product species: the degradation products are not observed and tracking them would add an unidentifiable state. Synthesis is deliberately absent per the intent's scope_exclusions — the experiment starts at washout.

parameters.source: no reporter-specific value supplied; placeholder chosen so that the nominal half-life sits inside the 10 h observation window
description states starting levels sit around 8 to 12 on the calibrated scale; the low end of that range is taken as the nominal

decisions.decision: First-order (mass-action) degradation of A with no synthesis term.
alternatives_considered: retain a synthesis term with a washout-time step

decisions.decision: The initial level is an estimated parameter A0 entering through the antimony initial assignment A = A0, rather than a fixed number read off the t=0 measurements.
alternatives_considered: fix A(0) to the mean of the two t=0 readings
fix A(0) to 10 as the midpoint of the stated 8-12 range

decisions.decision: No growth-dilution term, following the description's statement that cells were held at low density in stationary phase and the intent's scope_exclusions.
alternatives_considered: add a dilution rate constant and let it absorb part of the observed loss
decisions.question: A dilution term would be exactly collinear with k1 under a single condition — the data cannot separate them, so adding it would convert a finite CI into an unbounded one. If the intent ever requires degradation as distinct from total loss, a second condition varying growth rate is needed.

species.denotes: the fluorescent reporter A, measured as A_conc on an approximately absolute concentration scale
species.unit_convention: absolute concentration units of the calibrated reader; no scale factor expected
species.lump_membership: A is the single reporter state

parameters.convention: same concentration units as A; the lab note puts it around 8-12
